rounds: I learned more from YouTube than from school.
Paying for private tutoring is unfair on children whose parents can’t afford it.
Using AI to write an essay is no worse than copying from a friend.
School should start at ten o’clock, not eight.
A really good app could teach maths better than an average teacher.
Primary school children shouldn’t use screens in class at all.
Exam results say very little about how clever someone is.
In twenty years, children won’t need to go to a school building to learn.
